title: Positive-measure subsets of compact abelian groups have Bohr neighborhoods in triple endomorphism sumsets for commuting finite-index maps summing to zero
author: Anh N. Le and Thái Hoàng Lê
difficulty_reason: The argument constructs positive Fourier kernels on Bohr sets and an energy-controlled structured/error/uniform decomposition for arbitrary compact abelian groups. Its counting lemma turns this decomposition into a quantitative Khintchine-Roth lower bound. Uniform Fourier continuity and a homomorphism image identity then produce a Bohr neighborhood in the three-image sumset.
